critical.issue: PostgreSQL DB at Render is not accepting connections (TCP OK, but immediate termination). Every DB call returns 500 'Erreur serveur'. Backend log: 'PrismaClientInitializationError: Server has closed the connection.' This blocks running any auth flow, isolation test, CRUD test, etc.

minor.issue: The isolation check uses AND logic: `member.associationId !== req.associationId && year.associationId !== req.associationId`. In current data-model both entities always share the same associationId so this behaves correctly, BUT defensively-correct code should use OR logic (reject if EITHER differs). Not exploitable today, but a data-inconsistency (or future schema change) would silently bypass the check. Recommend switching `&&` to `||`.

File still present although problem statement (item 3) marked it obsolete. It still references live prisma tables (PlatformConfig, SuperAdmin) and is functionally used to seed the DB. Either keep it and remove it from the 'obsolete' list, or delete it if truly unused. Currently ambiguous.

critical_code_review_comments: Security-fix isolation logic (payments.js PUT/DELETE, exceptional.js PUT/DELETE payments) is functionally correct given the current schema invariants, but the AND (`&&`) predicate is weaker than OR (`||`). Recommend OR for defense-in-depth.

JWT_SECRET enforcement is implemented CORRECTLY in both middleware/auth.js (lines 8-13) and routes/platform.js (lines 10-15) via `process.exit(1)`. Verified statically. Runtime verification blocked by DB outage.
.gitignore correctly ignores .env, *.env, *.env.*, frontend/.env, backend/.env (verified). Fix #2 confirmed.
No SQLite files remaining under /app/backend and /app/backend/prisma. Fix #5 confirmed.

The default JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is `assocmanager_jwt_secret_key_change_in_production_12345` - this is functional but is still a weak/predictable default and the comment in .env.example says 'MUST be changed in production'. Fix #6 addressed (var required) but production deployment MUST override this value.

Prisma singleton in middleware/auth.js does not handle graceful reconnect on 'Server has closed the connection' errors. In production this could cascade many 500s; consider adding a retry/reconnect policy or the Prisma Data Proxy.

SuperAdmin JWT (platform.js) uses field name `id`, whereas admin JWT (auth.js -> generateJWT) uses `userId`. This asymmetry is fine because they go through different middlewares, but it's a maintenance hazard - unify on a single claim name.

The condition uses optional chaining `existingPayment.member?.associationId`. If Prisma returned null for `member` due to a foreign-key inconsistency, the check would evaluate `undefined !== req.associationId` = true; combined with AND on year, still safe. With OR it would also be safe. Fine.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of test blockage: the DATABASE_URL in /app/backend/.env targets a Render free-tier PostgreSQL that has stopped serving queries. Symptoms: TCP handshake succeeds on port 5432 to 35.227.164.209 but the server immediately terminates the SSL/auth phase - error is `Connection terminated unexpectedly` (pg node driver) / `Server has closed the connection` (Prisma). Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/platform/login` returns 500. Direct pg client from container also fails. Mitigation: provision a new Postgres (Neon, Supabase or paid Render), update DATABASE_URL, run `npx prisma migrate deploy`, then `node scripts/init-platform.js` to reseed SuperAdmin. All code fixes for the 6 items are already committed; only runtime verification is pending.
